summary: The base Check Point External Risk Management package (formerly Cyberint): discovery of everything the company exposes to the internet, plus brand protection against impersonation.
value: It shows every domain, IP and cloud resource the company exposes, and their vulnerabilities.
Fake sites and look-alike domains using the brand are found and taken down.
An agentless cloud service: nothing to install.
simple: Check Point External Risk Management (formerly Cyberint) — part of Check Point Exposure Management: an agentless cloud service that looks for threats outside the perimeter. Finds all the company’s internet-facing resources (domains, subdomains, IPs, cloud resources) and their vulnerabilities and misconfigurations with a risk score; looks for lookalike domains, phishing sites and brand abuse; monitors leaked credentials and account takeover; provides news, ransomware watch, Check Point Research reports and indicator-of-compromise searches. Licensed by number of external assets; “coins” pay for takedowns of fraudulent resources and investigations. Weekly scanning, one user. Dark web collection and search, leak detection, the threat knowledgebase and supplier intelligence are in higher packages.
notIncluded: Dark web sources and leaks, the threat knowledge base and supplier intelligence come with Advanced, Complete and Elite.
classification: ASM is EASM, Brand Protection is the brand protection class.
Credentials & Account Takeover monitoring is not dark web monitoring (like Account Leak in Rapid7) and stays in the text.
The Essential datasheet includes social media impersonation while the author’s table does not; it does not affect the classes.
